# Git history rewrite 2026-09-26

On 2026-09-26 the **unpushed** local history was rewritten with `git filter-repo`
to drop build-output blobs larger than 1 MB under `artifacts/`, `tmp/` and
`*/TestResults/` (old installers, dmg/zip/apk packages, release staging copies,
test hang dumps). `.git` went from 12.6 GB to the size recorded below.

- Commits already on GitHub (`origin/*`) were **not** rewritten; no force push
  is needed.
- The production line `fix/ultra-probe-single-reader` has a byte-identical tree
  before and after (9aaea9b1 -> 3ef59062).
- `master` and older branches that still tracked those binaries lost them from
  tracking, matching commit 9b484db9 ("stop tracking scratch/build output").
- Every rewritten commit got a new hash. Old hashes quoted in docs, handoffs,
  commit messages or the production `artifacts/versions.json` `source_commit`
  fields map to the new ones below.

Production manifest `source_commit` values:

| old | new | used by |
|---|---|---|
| 6ca68ac9 | b5b016e9 | release test baseline |
| f18d01fb | e1e2d083 | macOS client app/update packages |
| 906efe97 | 5c90ed92 | Ultra client runtimes |
